operations.title: S2 Community Detection Crash Recovery: From Cold Starts to State-Based Idempotence
operations.content: S2 community detection faced three coupled bugs that created 76 duplicate communities on April 15 (id:c46084ff). Root cause cascade: (1) _last_run_timestamp SQL query lacked unit filter and date sorting (id:5b8e39e9), (2) encoder crash on malformed LLM operations crashed entire batch (id:ce8d9aef), (3) incomplete success detection treated '0 actions' as failure (id:10db439b). Tom's insight: "isn't the best way not to filter by traces but just by the nodes without communities?" (id:dd301b34) — state-based approach replaces trace archaeology. New architecture: find nodes without community_member edges → process those → done. Crash-safe, idempotent, no timestamp guessing. Pattern: prefer data structure state over historical log reconstruction. Lessons apply to any incremental system needing crash-safety.
operations.situation: When S2 community detection fails or produces unexpected cold starts, or when building crash-safe incremental processing pipelines
operations.keywords: S2 community detection state-based idempotent cold start crash-safe nodes without edges duplicate prevention

operations.title: Graph Reasoning Opportunity: From Field Consensus to Personal Knowledge Graphs
operations.content: The KG fine-tuning field converges on one approach: flatten graph structure into text, enrich with chain-of-thought reasoning, fine-tune language model on enriched text (id:23364a94). Every major method (KG-FIT, KG-SFT, community-based) does this same flattening exercise. Academic papers (PoG, GCR, ReMindRAG, FastKGE) solve multi-hop reasoning over massive public KGs at ICML/NeurIPS caliber (id:516ec716). Consumer memory products (Mem0, GBrain) solve retrieval without training (id:e51cc55a). Gap nobody fills: personal knowledge graphs rich enough for graph reasoning but small enough for laptop training — 2000 nodes, 10K edges, 114 communities, correction chains, operator curation. Market opportunity: apply proven graph traversal techniques (PoG's path exploration, GCR's constrained decoding, FastKGE's incremental LoRA) to personal brain. Techniques are research-proven; the personal knowledge application is the unique opening (id:dbc297b0).
operations.situation: When evaluating whether to train brain-specific models, reviewing KG fine-tuning literature, or deciding between graph reasoning vs memory product positioning

operations.title: Keyword Fallback Penalty Tuning: Preventing Unembedded Node Dominance
operations.content: Bug-to-parameter cycle: keyword-only fallback was outranking embedding matches (id:d12224ea). Root: unembedded nodes scored high on keywords alone, drowning out embedded nodes with partial keyword overlap. Solution: KEYWORD_FALLBACK_WEIGHT=0.10 parameter penalizes keyword-only matches (id:ab61fa43), forcing embedded results to compete fairly (id:68c93af1). Pattern: phase 0.5B fix surfaces a general principle — retrieval ranking needs asymmetric weight treatment when mixing embedding and keyword signals. All three nodes explore similarity patterns (100% similarity_and_analogy signature).
